## Recent Clinical Updates

SGT-003 has been generally well tolerated in the 40 participants dosed as of March 11, 2026. More recent data shows that SGT-003 has been generally well tolerated in the 41 participants dosed as of March 18, 2026.

The company announced that the first participant has been dosed in IMPACT DUCHENNE, the Company's multi-country, placebo-controlled, randomized, double-blind, Phase 3 clinical trial investigating SGT-003 for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy. ## Regulatory Plans

In the first half of 2026, the company plans to have additional meetings with the FDA to receive guidance on a potential accelerated approval pathway for SGT-003 and expects to provide regulatory and clinical updates in mid-2026.

## Overview

Solid Biosciences announced that the first participant was dosed in FALCON, a Phase 1b, first-in-human clinical trial evaluating SGT-212 for the treatment of Friedreich's ataxia, with an initial data update expected in the second half of 2026.

## About SGT-212

SGT-212 is a first-in-class investigational gene therapy that employs a dual-route administration designed to target the neurologic, cardiac and systemic manifestations of the disease. It is delivered through a precise, stereotactic, MRI-guided intradentate nuclei infusion to the cerebellar dentate nuclei followed by an intravenous infusion, with the goal of restoring therapeutic levels of frataxin.

## FALCON Trial Details

FALCON is a first-in-human, open-label, multi-center Phase 1b clinical trial designed to evaluate the safety and tolerability of SGT-212 in participants aged 18-40 who have been diagnosed with FA and cardiac hypertrophy. The study will enroll multiple cohorts, with the first cohort enrolling non-ambulatory individuals, and a plan to enroll ambulatory individuals in a future cohort.

As of March 31, 2026, Solid Biosciences had $380.7 million in cash, cash equivalents, and available-for-sale securities, with the company expecting this to fund operations into the first half of 2028.

## Recent Financing

The company executed a $226 million private placement in March 2026, extending its operational runway into the first half of 2028.

# SLDB — Solid Biosciences — Research Block (live, as of 2026-06-21)

**Price check:** Confirmed SLDB closed ~$8.34 on 2026-06-18 (intraday $7.49–$8.42). [stockanalysis/Yahoo via search, 2026-06-18] — consistent with the portfolio's $8.35 mark.

### 1. Company / lead asset
- **SLDB = Solid Biosciences Inc.** (NASDAQ: SLDB). AAV **gene therapy** company.
- **Lead program: SGT-003**, microdystrophin gene therapy for **Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD)**. Now in **Phase 3 IMPACT DUCHENNE** (randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled); first participant dosed ~April 2026. Earlier Phase 1/2 INSPIRE DUCHENNE generated supportive biomarker/biopsy data (41 dosed as of 2026-03-18).
- **Pipeline breadth (cardiac/neuro):** SGT-212 (Friedreich's ataxia, Phase 1b FALCON), SGT-501 (CPVT), SGT-601 (TNNT2 dilated cardiomyopathy). [investors.solidbio.com; BioSpace; stocktitan — Feb–Apr 2026]

### 2. What drove the recent run (early-to-mid June 2026)
- **No new clinical data readout.** The move was driven by **analyst/sentiment + conference visibility + a corporate (share authorization) event**, not fresh trial results:
  - **2026-06-03: H.C. Wainwright raised PT to $25 from $20 (Buy maintained)**, citing **SGT-212 FALCON progress** (2 FA patients dosed, no SAEs). [investing.com, 2026-06-03]
  - **Conference circuit:** Jefferies Global Healthcare (2026-06-03) and **Goldman Sachs 47th Healthcare Conf (2026-06-08)** presentations. [BioSpace/Seeking Alpha, June 2026]
  - **2026-06-10 annual meeting:** shareholders approved **doubling authorized shares 240M → 480M** (executed same day). [stocktitan/TipRanks, 2026-06-10] — expands future financing capacity.
- Search sources also note **technical momentum** (momentum indicator turned positive 2026-06-01) and a multi-week run off mid-May lows. **Verdict: largely analyst-sentiment + beta/momentum, not a fundamental data catalyst.**

### 3. Did the thesis materially improve, or did price move ahead of fundamentals?
- **Thesis mostly UNCHANGED in June.** The de-risking events are older: **FDA Type C alignment on Phase 3 design (announced 2026-02-09)** and first Phase 3 dosing (~April). June added a higher sell-side target and conference exposure but **no new efficacy/safety data**. **Price moved ahead of unchanged June fundamentals** — the run is a re-rating, not a new clinical milestone.

### 4. Next known catalyst + timing
- **Mid-2026 FDA regulatory update on SGT-003 accelerated-approval pathway** (confirmatory-evidence alignment) — company guides **"mid-2026."** This is the near-term needle-mover. [investors.solidbio.com; CureDuchenne; marketbeat — Feb 2026 guidance]
- **SGT-212 FALCON (Friedreich's ataxia) initial data: 2H 2026.** [globenewswire, 2026-01-12]

### 5. Is the next catalyst binary / has easy money been made?
- The mid-2026 FDA accelerated-approval-pathway update is **regulatory and meaningfully binary-ish** (clarity on accelerated approval is a major value inflection for a single-asset-dominant gene therapy name). **Stock has already re-rated from mid-May lows (search cites ~$2.41 mid-May to >$7) to $8.34** on sentiment, so a substantial portion of optimism is priced in ahead of the catalyst. Easy/early momentum money appears largely captured; remaining upside is event-gated on the FDA outcome (and 2H FALCON data).

### 6. Financing / dilution / offering flags
- **March 2026: ~$240M private placement** (14.97M shares @ $5.61 + 27.8M pre-funded warrants; ~$226M net). Recent and dilutive. [stocktitan, March 2026]
- **2026-06-10: authorized shares doubled to 480M** — raises **future dilution capacity** (flag, not an active raise).
- **Two Form S-3 shelf registrations on file (FY2026)** [SEC EDGAR] — standard shelf capacity; enables future ATM/offerings. No confirmation a fresh offering is currently being executed at $8.
- **Cash: $380.7M as of 2026-03-31; runway guided into 1H 2028.** Burn ~$47.2M/quarter (rising). **No imminent financing pressure** — but well-funded names at higher prices sometimes opportunistically raise. (No active ATM draw verified.)

### 7. Main risk (next 1–3 months)
- **Regulatory/headline risk on the mid-2026 FDA accelerated-approval update** — a disappointing or ambiguous outcome could unwind the June re-rating. Single-asset concentration (SGT-003) amplifies this.
- **Dilution overhang** from the freshly doubled share authorization + active shelves; an opportunistic raise into strength is plausible at $8 vs. $5.61 March placement.
- **Sector/beta reversal** — much of the June move was sentiment/momentum, vulnerable to gene-therapy sector rotation.

### 8. Sources (URL + date)
- Q1 2026 10-Q / cash position: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001707502/000119312526219337/sldb-20260331.htm (filed Q2 2026; cash as of 2026-03-31)
- $240M private placement: https://www.stocktitan.net/news/SLDB/solid-biosciences-announces-oversubscribed-240-million-private-h1lzpng34cuj.html (March 2026)
- Doubling authorized shares / annual meeting (2026-06-10): https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/solid-biosciences-shareholders-approve-directors-and-share-increase
- H.C. Wainwright PT $20→$25 (2026-06-03): https://www.investing.com/news/analyst-ratings/hc-wainwright-raises-solid-biosciences-price-target-on-fa-trial-progress-93CH-4724031
- Goldman Sachs conf transcript (2026-06-08): https://seekingalpha.com/article/4913075-solid-biosciences-inc-sldb-presents-at-goldman-sachs-47th-annual-global-healthcare-conference
- June investor conferences: https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/solid-biosciences-to-participate-at-upcoming-june-2026-investor-conferences
- FDA Type C positive feedback / Phase 3 alignment (2026-02-09): https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/02/09/3234485/0/en/Solid-Biosciences-Announces-Positive-Feedback-from-Type-C-Meeting-with-FDA-for-SGT-003-Gene-Therapy-for-Duchenne-Muscular-Dystrophy.html
- Phase 3 IMPACT DUCHENNE first dosing: https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/solid-biosciences-doses-first-participant-in-phase-3-impact-duchenne-clinical-trial-evaluating-sgt-003-in-duchenne-muscular-dystrophy
- SGT-212 FALCON (FA), 2H 2026 data (2026-01-12): https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/01/12/3216871/0/en/Solid-Biosciences-Doses-First-Participant-in-First-in-Class-Phase-1b-FALCON-Trial-Evaluating-SGT-212-Dual-Route-Gene-Therapy-for-the-Treatment-of-Friedreich-s-Ataxia.html
- Mid-2026 FDA accelerated-approval guidance: https://cureduchenne.org/research/solid-plans-to-seek-fda-guidance-in-2026-for-duchenne-gene-therapy-candidate-sgt-003-s/
- Price on 2026-06-18 ($8.34 close): https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/sldb/ and https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/SLDB/history/

**Unverified:** exact magnitude of the cited mid-May $2.41 base (came from a forecast-site snippet, not a primary source); whether any ATM is currently being actively drawn at ~$8.

**Bottom line for decision table:** Top-gainer move was **sentiment/analyst/momentum-driven (PT hike + conferences + share-authorization), NOT new fundamental data** — thesis unchanged since the Feb FDA alignment. Next real catalyst is the **mid-2026 FDA accelerated-approval-pathway update** (binary, event-gated), with FALCON data in 2H. Well-funded (runway to 1H 2028) but **dilution capacity just doubled** and shelves are live. No recommendation given.
